product_one_liner.value: Vertical Insure enables vertical SaaS platforms to embed tailored, white-label insurance into their existing customer workflows, while handling insurance operations, claims, and customer support.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plan page was found; the pricing URL did not return a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: These are platforms documented in customer success stories as using the embedded insurance offering, not merely ecosystem partners or investors.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 53 employees; a separate funding database reports 48, so headcount sources differ.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2022. PitchBook lists 2020 under the former entity name Nextera Centacorn; this answer uses the Vertical Insure company-profile founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index contains industry, product strategy, insurance, and integration marketing articles, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists account management, strategic accounts, marketing, product management, and client development roles; no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title is listed.

model_provider.notes: No publicly identified production model/provider was found in the developer documentation, AI-related product pages, blog, or privacy/security disclosures; no public subprocessor list was found. Claude is named in a customer story as Lodgix’s coding assistant, not as Vertical Insure’s production model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy explicitly labels a section GDPR Compliance; this is a legal compliance claim rather than an independently awarded certificate. Payment documentation claims PCI compliance but does not explicitly name PCI DSS; no SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA certification claim was located.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook labels the August 2026 financing Series A1 and reports $21 million. The company announced Updata-led financing on August 4 without disclosing its amount or stage.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 4, 2026 financing announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A directly accessible Enterprise Account Executive posting describes an open role, although it is not included in the short job-board index returned.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 28, 2026, it announced the launch of embedded Builder’s Risk Insurance inside Ressio, entering construction management software; this falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ryan Kasprzak’s profile dates his start as Chief Underwriting Officer to April 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales postings explicitly require logging activity in HubSpot CRM; the marketing role requires building HubSpot campaigns, forms, emails, and workflows. Salesforce is mentioned only as alternative experience, not confirmed use.
